p: God: Here appears that horrible conflict, which he sustained between faith and desperation.
roaring: Being tormented with extreme anguish.
praises of Israel: He means the place of praising, even the tabernacle or else it is so called, because he gave the people continuous opportunity to praise him.
worm: And seeming most miserable of all creatures, which referred to Christ, and in this appears the unspeakable love of God for man, that he would thus abase his son for our sakes.
womb: Even from my birth you have given me opportunity to trust in you.
belly: For unless God's providence preserves the infants, they would perish a thousand times in the mother's womb.
bulls of Bashan have beset me: He means that his enemies were so fat, proud and cruel that they were more like beasts than men.
water: Before he spoke of the cruelty of his enemies, and now he declares the inward grief of the mind, so that Christ was tormented both in soul and body.
hast brought me into the dust: You permitted me to be without all hope of life.
pierced my hands and my feet: Thus David complained as though he were nailed by his enemies in both hands and feet, but this was accomplished in Christ.
darling from the power of the: My life that is solitary, left alone and forsaken by all, Ps 35:17,25:16
Save me from the lion's mouth: Christ is delivered with a more mighty deliverance by overcoming death, than if he had not tasted death at all.
praise him: He promises to exhort the Church that they by his example might praise the Lord.
afflicted: The poor afflicted are comforted by this example of David, or Christ.
vows before them that fear him: Which were sacrifices of thanksgiving which they offered by God's commandment, when they were delivered out of any great danger.
The meek shall eat and be: He alludes still to the sacrifice.
upon earth shall eat and worship: Though the poor are first named as in Ps 22:26 yet the wealthy are not separated from the grace of Christ's kingdom.
and none can keep alive his: In whom there is no hope that he will recover life: so neither poor nor rich, quick nor dead will be rejected from his kingdom.
A seed shall serve him: Meaning, the prosperity which the Lord keeps as a seed to the Church to continue his praise among men.
done this: That is, God has fulfilled his promise.
